senses.gloss: अदेय a. (f. या) Improper to be given away (in civil law). Wife, sons, deposits and some other things are considered as अदेय in Hindu law.
अदेय a. (f. या) Improper to be given away (in civil law). Wife, sons, deposits and some other things are considered as अदेय in Hindu law.
अदेव (II) m. One who is not a god.
अदेव-मातृक a. not having the god Indra as mother, i.e. not rained upon, वितन्वति क्षेममदेवमातृकाश्चिराय तस्मिन् कुरवश्चकासते Kir.i.17. (Cf. देवो ववर्ष.)
अदेश m. 1. A bad or improper place; 2. a bad country.

आदेश m. 1. Advice, instruction, precept, आदेशं देशकालज्ञः शिष्यः शासितुरानतः R.i.92; 2. account, information; 3. a command, आदेशो वनवासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल Ram.; 4. a prediction, राजद्विष्टादेशकृत् Yaj.ii.304; 5. a substitute (in gram.), धातोः स्थान इवादेशं सुग्रीवं संन्यवेशयत् R.xii.58.
आदेवन n. 1. Gambling; 2. a die used in gambling; 3. a board for gambling.
